biggest_catch: There is a $0 annual fee, so the 20,000 points (a $200 cash redemption value) is yours to keep net — but Wells Fargo says offers can differ by marketing channel, so you must apply through the specific offer page via Apply now or the offer may not attach.
catches: Only pursue spending you already planned to do — never overspend just to chase a bonus; buying things to hit a threshold wipes out the bonus math and is how people lose money on this.
You must select Apply now from the offer page — Wells Fargo states offers may differ by marketing channel, so applying through another channel may show a different offer.
The bonus requires $1,000 in purchases within the first 3 months — keep it to your already-planned spending.
Wells Fargo's page did not state the bonus posting timing in the fetched copy — do not assume a date.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, which can temporarily dip your credit score by a few points.
The card's variable APR (around 20%+) will erase the entire bonus in a month or two if you carry a balance — pay the full statement balance every month.

steps: Go to the official Wells Fargo Autograph page https://creditcards.wellsfargo.com/autograph-visa-credit-card/ and read the 20,000-point offer terms.
Select Apply now from that page so the offer attaches (offers can differ by channel) and get approved; save your approval confirmation.
Spend at least $1,000 in purchases — your already-planned spending — within the first 3 months.
Pay the full statement balance every month so interest never eats the bonus.
Track the 20,000 points posting; Wells Fargo did not state a posting lag on the fetched page, so check your rewards balance.
